rounds: Two weeks of the Joy Police running pretty clean. Routine locked in, same clothes, going through the motions — they kept things small and manageable and the visibility stayed low. Then the Apollo ring moment: colleague asks, you had the perfect opening, and you closed it. Not a disaster. But they got that one.
pattern: They're letting the body show up but keeping the mouth shut.
focus: One stranger, one true thing — next time someone asks about the ring, you give them one real sentence.
